reason: I'd download it for the free first appointment summary since my appointment is coming up, but that plus free logging and the basic doctor PDF covers what I need this month, so I wouldn't pay yet. I'd only consider Pro after I see whether the summary actually gets my doctor to take me seriously.
objection: Cycle predictions have never worked for my irregular cycles, and 'drawn from the 2023 guideline' means nothing to me unless every suggested question links to the actual guideline recommendation so I can check it isn't wellness fluff.
would_change_my_mind: If the free summary visibly helped in my appointment (clinician actually used it, got me toward a diagnosis or labs) and Pro showed cited guideline sources for each question, I'd pay for the next appointment.
